sources.snippet: Overview SmolLM2-135M-Instruct is a compact language model with 135 million parameters built by HuggingFaceTB using a Transformer decoder architecture trained on 2 trillion tokens with bfloat16 precision. The model supports instruction-following, text rewriting, summarization, and function calling tasks while remaining lightweight enough to run on consumer hardware including CPU. Training ...
